subject: Trial extension & one-off credit ask — Tailwind POC
messages:
From: Danielle Green <danielle.green@tailwind.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tailwind Legal <legal@tailwind.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: short trial extension + top-up credit for POC

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Tailwind is excited about the latency gains. We're prepping a live demo for our board the week after next and I ran the numbers: our current POC credits will run out mid-demo unless we top up.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend our trial window by 30 days?
- Can you apply a one-off trial credit to the account (roughly ~40k tokens) so we can run the full end-to-end scenario?

If there are standard approvals you need, happy to provide a short commercial note from our VP of Product. We need to lock this by COB next Wednesday (2027-11-08) to keep the timeline.

Appreciate it — Danielle

Danielle Green
Head of Integrations, Tailwind.ai
danielle.green@tailwind.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: short trial extension + top-up credit for POC

Karthik / Neha — forwarding an inbound from Tailwind. Good opportunity: product likes our perf but they need a little runway to finish the board demo.

Context: Tailwind is mid-POC, usage profile attached (tailwind-usage-20271101.pdf). They specifically asked for ~40k tokens and a 30-day extension. They're not yet on a committed plan — looks like a small expansion opportunity if the board signs off.

Can we grant a one-off credit + extension from sales authority? If not, who needs to sign off and estimated turnaround? If approved, I will send the formal offer and attach an amended MPA stub for their legal.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short trial extension + top-up credit for POC

Monica —

Thanks for the note and the usage attachment. Approve a one-time, non-recurring credit of 40,000 tokens and a 30-day trial extension for Tailwind.ai. Please include the following conditions in the offer:
- Credit expires if account not activated into paid subscription within 45 days of acceptance.
- Credit is non-transferrable and not refundable.

Log the credit under deal DW-8342. Finance OKs token-level credits for POCs up to this amount with manager approval. Keep the amended MPA minimal; legal can handle later redlines.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Green <danielle.green@tailwind.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Tailwind Legal <legal@tailwind.ai>
Date: 2027-11-08T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension + top-up credit for POC

Hi Danielle —

Good news: we can do a one-off top-up to keep your demo on track. Offer details below (applies to Tailwind.ai POC account):

- One-time credit: 40,000 tokens applied immediately upon your written acceptance.
- Trial extension: 30 days added to your current trial window.
- Conditions: credit expires if you do not convert to a paid plan within 45 days of acceptance; credit is non-transferable.

Attached: amended-mpa-stub.pdf (for legal review) and a DocuSign offer link (docusign-offer-link.txt) if you want the formal acceptance path.

Next step: if this works, confirm via email and I'll apply the credit and push the extension. If you'd prefer, we can route a short one-page commercial letter to your VP of Product for approval.

We aim to have the credit applied within 24 hours of your confirmation.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: amended-mpa-stub.pdf (doc), tailwind-usage-20271101.pdf (report), docusign-offer-link.txt (link)
